statement: All coherent provisional/final square and cube variants pass to every shift; W_D is unchanged by any nonempty shift.
notes: No counterexample holding before but failing after a shift can exist for these formulations.

statement: Unrestricted provisional Der6 and dual Der6prime are the two separate half-stability implications.
depends_on: corner Kan extensions; connective complexes model
notes: Connective model and its formal dual separate the two halves; Der1–5 specified.

statement: Final Der6 does not force pointedness: the strong derivator of spectra over nonzero E has all squares bicartesian and W_D=W_Z.
Every strong derivator satisfying final Der6 has an RT-fixed constant-coefficient localizer, without model or pointedness assumptions.
notes: Stable pointed envelope, conservative free pointing, natural retract splitting, and spectral annihilator proved.

statement: Der8 first two implications are automatic; third follows from finalDer6 but can fail without it; Der8 alone does not force reverse excision or RT-fixedness.
depends_on: A2.4; GPS6.1; finite lattices N5 and 2-chain
notes: All finite square maps checked by code; ∅→e witnesses failure of RT-fixedness for 2-chain.

statement: A complete and cocomplete infinity category has identical pushout and pullback squares iff it is a slice of a complete and cocomplete stable infinity category.
depends_on: A2.4 pointing construction; coherent slice pullbacks
notes: Enhanced case; no assertion that every bare strong derivator is infinity-category enhanced.

statement: For every bare strong derivator, final Der6 iff its pointed envelope is stable and free pointing is conservative and preserves homotopy pullbacks.
notes: Exact canonical characterization independent of the additional slice parametrization.

statement: The replacement HOT margin asserting that a bicartesian square over a point has a contractible middle vertex is false.
depends_on: D.5; join model; integral chain contraction; van Kampen and Hurewicz
notes: Both middle vertices are the acyclic noncontractible finite Higman presentation complex; join is contractible. Exact connected-CW tensor criterion given.

statement: Either unrestricted one-sided square axiom implies that W_D is RT-fixed for a strong derivator.
depends_on: Cisinski pointed-space action; conservative free pointing; Brown all-CW representation; cofiber exactness from Der5
notes: No regularity or stabilization premise; opposite invariance stated explicitly; restricted coefficient converses not asserted.

statement: For pointed strong derivators the constant, locally constant, and arbitrary coefficient versions of each provisional axiom are equivalent.
depends_on: Three-edge tree; natural counital comultiplication; additive shifts; free-circle splitting; GPS Lemmas5.12–5.13
notes: Bare derivators; unpointed converse remains separate.

statement: Constant Der6prime makes the pointed envelope satisfy unrestricted pushout-implies-pullback; dual statement for the copointed envelope.
depends_on: A2.10 coherent tree and fold splitting; derived pointing; additive split-cofiber Puppe exactness
notes: Independent parent audit passed; constant-only affine transfer is refuted by A2.12, while A2.13 transfers under locally constant coefficients.

statement: Constant provisional coefficients need not imply locally constant coefficients for unpointed strong derivators.
depends_on: Labelled connective augmented complexes; right adjoint label reset; five-object locally constant test; integral kernel certificate
notes: Accessible infinity category, all small diagrams and Der1–5 verified; opposite gives dual; its localizer remains W_Z.

statement: For every strong derivator the locally constant and arbitrary coefficient versions of each provisional axiom are equivalent.
depends_on: A2.11; five-object split-coproduct reconstruction in every shift; commuting right Kan extensions
notes: Together with A2.10 and A2.12 gives exact pointed/unpointed coefficient classification; either LC half implies RT-fixedness.

statement: For homotopy derivators of complete and cocomplete infinity categories either constant provisional axiom already forces RT-fixedness.
depends_on: Genuine slices; A2.11 natural retract; A2.9 Brown spectrum tests; constant-hocolim pushout formula
notes: Enhanced only; no accessibility assumption. W_C is the intersection of the localizers of all retractive envelopes over M. Bare strong-derivator extension remains separate.
